name: TOKYO CHRONOS
source:
Spring 2018. 
Kyosuke Sakurai—you—awaken in the city of Shibuya, Tokyo, oddly quiet and devoid of its bustle.

Nobody is around. The only exception is the group of eight childhood friends which you used to be part of.

As the group gathers in the city's famous scramble crossing, a blood-red message flashes on a nearby electronic billboard.

"I am dead. Who killed me?"

If this world is similar to the Chronos Worlds that had emerged in the past, there is only one way out—to find the one causing this strange phenomenon and kill them.

[From [url=https://tokyochronos.com/lp_en/]English official website[/url]]
translation:
2018年春季。
樱井京介——你——在东京涩谷醒来，这里出奇地安静，没有喧嚣。

周围没有人。唯一的例外是你曾经所在的八个儿时好友。

当这群人聚集在该市著名的十字路口时，附近的电子广告牌上闪烁着血红色的信息。

“我死了，谁杀了我？”

如果这个世界和过去出现的时空世界类似，那么只有一个出路——找到造成这种奇怪现象的人，然后杀掉他们。

[来自[url=https://tokyochronos.com/lp_en/]英文官网[/url]]
